english.title: Licence holder fail to comply with condition or requirement of water abstraction licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being, for the purposes of section 24 of the Water Resources Act 1991, the holder of a licence under chapter II of Part 2 of the Act, in circumstances not constituting a contravention of section 24(1) or (2) of the Act, did not comply with a condition or requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION OR REQUIREMENT..), imposed by the provisions of that licence in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24(4)(b) and (5) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
